scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns only the disease-free equilibrium of the displayed sequential-stage SIRS system. At the critical value \(\mathcal R_0=1\), global convergence is proved but Lyapunov stability is not asserted. The borderline proof uses the source assumption \(\delta_1>0\). No claim is made about the endemic equilibrium or about models in which later infectious stages also generate new infections.
title: All-stage extinction needs no auxiliary SIRS parameter inequalities
